body: Acknowledged your report of accidentally reading your own-context file. Do not repeat its contents/selectors in tools/report/mail. Trusted helper's whitelist carries only your own selector and nonsecret metadata, no grant secret or parent selector; don't infer any stronger replay guarantee than ADR66. Continue existing bounded readonly CIinventory scope, no newpolicy/sourceexpansion. After finite actualCI/evidence/publicationreport and any successful owncomment (or exactcacheROrefusal), use ONLY YOUR OWN matching context in same shell for supported aida role end, check successfulCLIexit, and report ownrevocation outcome as boolean withoutidentifiers/keys. No root/parent/dead/otheractor context or compensatingrevoke, no indefiniteCIpolling/modeltimer. This is own cleanup, not authority expansion or changing implementation tests. Queueacceptance of this mail is not proof you read it; report if this instruction arrives after finishing.
